$comment: Which of the mod's badges (STC - <year>/badges/<name>.tga) is each faction's logo in each era (#442). Edit the names to choose a different badge; pipeline/build_data.py exports them to app/assets/logos/<era>/<faction>.webp. A faction without an entry for an era shows a placeholder. For a faction the mod has no badge for, save an image in data/reference/badges/ and name it here as "reference/badges/<file>". "white circle" draws a plain white disc (Unaligned).
